dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Fire! Fire! Nononono, keep it away!
Not the fire, not the fire! Take the shinies instead!
Hot hot hot! Somebody put it out, not me!
Keep da beast off! Bite him, not me!
Shoo! Shoo! Nice doggy, go bite him instead!
Teeth! It got teeth! Why it got teeth?!
Dat's my blood! Mine! Can't waste it!
I'm leakin! Somebody get a rag, quick quick!
Too much red, I'm off, byeee!
To me! All of ya, stab him, go go go!
Up up up! Pile on, he's only one!
Get him! Get him! All together, so it ain't just me!
%1$s. I'm %2$s, of %3$s. Remember it, clever-clever. I will.
So you're da one! %2$s, of %3$s. Say it when you run, %1$s. Run fast!
Look close, %1$s. %2$s of %3$s. Pretty last face, eh?
You again, %1$s? Sneaky.
%1$s. I remember. I remember everything.
Back, %1$s? Heh. Good, good.
Runnin again, %1$s? Last time I only saw yer back. Nice back.
%1$s! Da runner! Not this time, not this time.
You ran from %2$s once, %1$s. Yer legs remember. Legs always remember.
You had me down, %1$s. Should've finished it. Silly.
%1$s. I healed. You healed? Heh.
Left me in da dirt, %1$s. Bad mistake. Bad bad.
%1$s spared me. Don't think I owe ya. I don't owe nobody.
You let me live, %1$s. Kind? Or dumb? Still thinkin.
%1$s. You stopped yer hand. I won't stop mine. Hee.
Didn't I kill ya, %1$s? Doin it proper dis time.
%1$s! I'm wearin yer face! Want the rest?
Back from dead, %1$s? Lie down. Lie down again.
%1$s. Knife at my throat, all da questions. Here's my answer.
You made me talk, %1$s. Now I make ya squeal.
%1$s. I told ya nothin. Nothin! ...Mostly nothin.
Not yet! Not yet!
Dat's all?
Not dyin today! Not me!
%s is finished! Shinies for me! Who's next?
I'm takin %s's boots! And shinies!
Dat's how %s goes. Remember, remember.
Who's captain now? %s! Clever-clever me!
Kneel, kneel! %s's in charge now!
I'm %s now. Say it! Say it nice!
Another trophy for %s! Mine, mine!
Up up up! %s climbs higher!
Who'll stop %s now? Not you!
%1$s! %1$s! Go go!
Three cheers for %s!
%1$s! Shinies for %1$s!
You thought I was dead, %1$s? Me too! Funny, eh?
%1$s! Crawled outta da dirt just for ya.
Look what ya did to me, %1$s. Now look what I do to you.
I wuz cold, %1$s. Somethin warmed me up. Not nice. Not nice at all.
Kill me, go on, %1$s. I seen da other side. Don't scare me no more.
%1$s. I remember da dark ya put me in. Brought some back for ya.
%1$s. Dey laugh at me cuz of you. Laugh!
You shamed me in front of my own, %1$s. I'll wash it off wit yer blood. Hee.
%1$s! Every night I dream yer face. Bad dreams!
You killed one of ours, %1$s. I'm here for da debt. Pay up.
%1$s. Somebody pays for him. You! Not me!
I swore it over his body, %1$s. Swore proper.
Ya killed my brother, %1$s! Ya killed him!
Brother's blood on ya, %1$s. I'm takin it back.
%1$s. I buried my brother. Now you.
Hands off %s, you!
Nobody pokes %s but me!
Brother! Comin, comin!
You... let me up? %1$s, yer a fool. Heh. Thanks.
Why, %1$s? Why spare me? What's the trick?
I won't forget dis, %1$s. Never.
Don't look! Nobody look at me!
%1$s... I'll get ya for dis. Get ya good.
No no no... not in front of da others...
%1$s. I knelt once. Dat's over, over.
I served ya, %1$s. Death let me go. I'm my own again. Free!
%1$s! My oath died. I didn't!
Think I'd kneel forever, %1$s? Silly.
%1$s. Wore yer leash. Now ya wear my knife.
Never was yours, %1$s. Just waitin. Patient, me.
Coward comes at last! %1$s, I waited all day!
%1$s! Yer challenge rotted on da gate. You will too.
Nail a challenge and run, %1$s? I'll nail ya up next.
Bend? I been dead, %1$s. Nothin left bends.
Yer light's nothin, %1$s. Kill me again. Try it.
Nothin scares me now, %1$s. Especially not you.
Too weak to own me, %1$s. Too weak!
Kneel, %1$s? I seen bigger! Seen better!
Ha! Dat all da fire ya got, %1$s?
Dat fire in ya, %1$s... I'll follow it. Heh.
You beat me fair, %1$s. My knife's yours now.
I know strong when it's standin on me. Lead, %1$s.
Wha... what'd ya put in my head, %1$s?
Hear an old voice givin orders. Yours now, %1$s.
My hands are yours, %1$s. Can't make 'em stop!
Not now, not now! Busy!
Nothin left of my old tribe to raid, %1$s. All gone.
%2$s? I know da back gate. Gimme till dawn, %1$s.
I'll grab all of %2$s's shinies and bring 'em, %1$s.
%2$s will bleed before sunrise, %1$s. Quietly.
Dey'll take me back, %1$s. Fools! I'll listen.
Two days, %1$s. I'll know all dey fears.
I'll sit at dey fire and count dey knives, %1$s.
Back, %1$s! Not empty-handed. Never.
Miss me, %1$s? Heh.
I'm here, %1$s. Where we goin? What's there?
Done kneelin.
Thought I was yours? Wuz waitin. Heh.
Back to my own. Watch yer back!
%1$s! Ya nailed dat on my gate! Come, then. Just us. ...Lads, stay close.
Back off, all! %1$s is mine! Mine!
So ya came, %1$s. My lads will watch. Lots of lads.
My captains stand. While %1$s of 'em live, no touchin me.
Ha! Go kill my captains first. All %1$s! Hee hee.
No seat for ya while %1$s of my captains still breathe.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.dialogue.c: Captain? We got no captain, %1$s.
Ask someone else, %1$s. I don't know nothin.
Nothin to tell, %1$s. Honest! Honest honest.
Okay okay, %1$s, okay! %2$s Don't hurt me!
Didn't hear it from me, %1$s. %2$s Not me!
Fine! %2$s Now let go, %1$s, let go!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: Dey say blades barely bite %s. Barely!
Arrows bounce right off %s, I hear. Don't waste yer arrows.
%s walks through fire like a warm bath. Weird, eh?
When %s hits ya, legs snap. Ask da limpers.
%s been left for dead before. Always gets back up! Annoyin.
Hurt %s and he gets worse. Faster, angrier. Don't hurt him!
%s smears somethin foul on his blades. Cuts go green! Green!
When %s starts bellowin, all of us come runnin. Can't help it.
%s died already. Whatever fixed him took da fear right out.
%s hates archers. Arrow went right through him once. Right through!
%s got a soft head. One good knock wit a club, stars!
%s only watches who he's fightin. Hit him from da side!
%s goes up like dry straw. Whoosh.
%s won't go near fire. Screams at a torch! Heh.
%s runs from wolves and bears and anybody on a horse.
Make %s bleed and he panics. Can't stand da sight.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.book.jaymo:
To da camp, from da king.

%1$s holds da road dis moon. Keep out of his way.

%2$s

Burn dis. Don't read it twice.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.news.jaymo: Nailed to a stake at the edge of %2$s's land, scratched in %1$s's hand: "%3$s, I'm comin for ya. Hee hee."
A rag on a spear outside the camps of %2$s, daubed in blood: %1$s means to kill %3$s.
Word from %2$s's camps: %1$s has sworn on his blade to see %3$s dead.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: There! Dat's him! Get him!
King wants yer head! Shinies for us!
Sniff sniff! Fresh trail!
No runnin! Not dis time, clever one!
%2$s heard da horn, %1$s! Where are dey?
King sent us. Friend of %2$s don't stand alone. Pay us in shinies, maybe.
Raiders on yer land, %1$s? Show us where, we stab 'em from behind!
Come out, come out!
Stab 'em for da king!
Where'd dey run? Where?
Nobody touches our friend! ...Our shiny friend.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.dialogue.c: Dey don't think of ya at all, %1$s. Keep it so.
You and %2$s? No quarrel. Yet. Heh.
Yer nothin to %2$s, %1$s. Stay nothin. Nothin's safe.
Yer name's come up round da fires, %1$s. Not nice things.
Round here, %2$s keep an eye on ya, %1$s. Many eyes.
Dey're countin, %1$s. Every one of ours ya killed.
King spits when yer name's said, %1$s.
Whole of %2$s wants ya skinned. Few bent coppers might help. Shinies help!
Walk soft out here, %1$s. Dey're angry. Real angry.
Dey sent hunters after ya, %1$s. I wouldn't linger.
Hunters of %2$s got yer scent. King put a price on ya. Big price!
Yer a dead thing walkin, %1$s, far as da king says.
Ya got a truce wit %2$s, %1$s. Don't be da one to break it.
Horn's been blown for ya. Dey let ya pass, for now.
Truce holds, %1$s. Stab one of us and it's done.
Dey like ya round %2$s's fires, %1$s. Call, and dey come!
King of %2$s says yer name like it's one of ours.
Friend of %2$s, ya are. Raiders at yer door? Horn goes up here too.
Empty hands, %1$s? Take %2$s bent coppers to cool da king.
No shinies, no peace. %2$s bent coppers, %1$s.
Nothin I want in dem hands. Come back wit %2$s bent coppers.
A start, %1$s. King wants more. Always more.
Some forgiven. Not all.
Takes da edge off. Only da edge.
Paid in full, %1$s. King forgets. For now.
Dat'll do! Yer name's clean round da fires.
Shiny! We're square, %1$s.
A gift? Nobody owes, still ya give! King'll hear of dis, %1$s.
Ha! Shiny, and for nothin! Strange one, %1$s. Good strange.
Gifts make friends round da fires. Remember dat, and so will we.
See da king? Beat our champion in da pit, %1$s. Then we talk.
Nobody walks in. Into da pit, %1$s, come out standin.
King's at da end of da hall, %1$s. Get there before da hall gets ya.
Run to da throne, %1$s. Mind yer feet. Hee hee.
Ya proved it already, %1$s. Don't push it.
King's seen ya. Once is plenty.
No king to see today.
Not now, %1$s. Go away. Shoo.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Fresh meat for da pit!
Get in here, little un! Hehe.
I'll fold ya in half!
Ha! Dat one can fight! Let 'em through!
Sneaky one! Da king likes sneaky ones!
Somethin's burnin on my brow... %1$s. I'll come when ya call.
I feel it! Yer mark, %1$s. Goin home. For now.
%1$s. Don't know what ya did. I'll know yer fight when I hear it.
FOR %1$s!! GO GO GO!!
A real blade? For me?! I'll stab where ya say, %1$s.
Mine won't know till it's too late, %1$s. Hee.
I'm yer knife in dey camp, %1$s. Sneaky sneaky.
I'm... not angry no more. I'll walk wit ya, %1$s.
Quiet in my head. Lead on, %1$s.
Hrm. %1$s. Goin where ya go.
Why's my head itchy, %1$s?
Leave me be, %1$s. Goin home.
Get out of my eyes! ...What'd ya do, %1$s?
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.speech.jay: Blood for da fire, fire, fire!
Drums! Drums! Get dem!
Feel da wolf! Wolf make ya quick!
Hee! Hee! HAAA!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.tail.jaymo: Sniff sniff. Tail-man! Hidin it, ha! Funny!
Ya stink of tail, %s! Why tie it up? Nobody here cares, heh.
Somethin wit a tail. Under da coat. We smell it. We smell everythin.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.dialogue.c: Please, %1$s! Don't! I tell ya everythin!
Wait wait wait! What d'ya wanna know?
Mercy, %1$s! Ask, I answer! Anythin!
Do it then, %1$s. Nothin from me. Nothin!
*spits* Go on. Ask yer questions.
I got nothin to say to ya.
Said nothin, sayin nothin.
Ask all ya like, %1$s. Ask, ask.
*they glare at you and say nothing*
All right! All right! Stop it!
No more, %1$s, please! I'll talk!
*they flinch from the edge* Fine! Ask!
Dat's all ya got?
*they grit their teeth and hold your stare*
Ya don't scare me, %1$s. ...Much.
Kill me or let me go. Done talkin.
*they shut their eyes and wait for the blow*
Nothin ya do makes me talk!
Agh! Stop stop! I talk, I talk! Anythin!
*they cry out* Enough, %1$s! Ask!
No more! Please! What d'ya want?
*they look away first* ...Fine. Ask.
Stop lookin at me like dat! I tell ya!
*their jaw trembles* What d'ya wanna know, %1$s?
*they stare right back*
Look all ya like.
Yer eyes don't scare me, %1$s. Much.
I swear it! Never touch ya, %1$s.
On my life, never lift a hand! Never!
I swear! Never again, %1$s! Never ever!
Nobody. I'm alone out here.
There's nobody, %1$s. Just me. Honest!
None of mine are near, I swear it!
There's %2$s of us about. %3$s carry knives.
%2$s within shoutin distance, %1$s. %3$s are guards.
Maybe %2$s nearby... %3$s wit weapons.
No one! Answer to no one!
No lord, %1$s. I'm nobody's.
There's no one. I swear it. Swear swear.
%2$s. Big boss %2$s, rules all %3$s. Don't tell!
I serve %3$s. %2$s sits da throne.
%2$s! It's %2$s of %3$s ya want, not me!
%2$s has no ruler now. Nobody's taken da seat.
Nobody rules %2$s just now. Dat's da truth.
Da seat of %2$s is empty, %1$s.
%2$s leads us, da whole of %3$s.
We run wit %2$s. Everyone in %3$s does.
%2$s's word, dat's what we live by. %3$s.
No home. Sleep where I fall.
Nowhere, %1$s. Ain't got nowhere. Nothin.
Home? Don't have one.
Da seat of %4$s is about %2$s blocks %3$s of here.
%4$s! Go %3$s, %2$s blocks or so. Maybe more, heh.
%3$s! Some %2$s blocks %3$s, dat's where %4$s's seat is!
Camp's %3$s of here. %2$s blocks, maybe.
Go %3$s, about %2$s blocks. Ya smell da fires.
%4$s, dat way, %3$s. %2$s blocks, maybe. Don't say I told ya!
Da captains? Nothin new, %1$s. Ya know much as me.
Told ya all I know, %1$s. All of it.
Quiet on da roads, %1$s. No word worth sellin.
Rumours ain't free, %1$s. %2$s bent coppers. Shiny ones.
Words ain't free, %1$s. %2$s bent coppers, and it's yours.
%2$s bent coppers, %1$s, and I whisper it. Shiny shiny.
Heh, pleasure pleasure, %1$s. Word is: %2$s
Lean in close, %1$s. %2$s
For you, %1$s: %2$s Didn't come from me!
Whatchu want, eh? Eh?
Hands out! Both! Where I can see 'em!
Ooh, walkin' right up to me, bold one, bold!
Quick-quick, talk or shoo!
Names is worth somethin'. Not givin' mine free!
Call me whatever. Won't matter soon, hehehe.
Nobody! Nobody at all! Next question.
Names is for friends! You's not a friend. Not yet, nope.
This ain't your place. My name ain't yours neither.
Keep yer hand! Gonna watch you first, I is.
Heard about your lot. Prove it wrong, then maybe names.
Others'll tell me if you's worth it. Till then, nuh-uh.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.speech.jay: Can't stick 'im from here! Movin', movin'!
He keeps hoppin'! Shift, shift!
Wrong spot! Sidestep, sidestep!
Missin' every time! New footin'!
No clear shot! Findin' a better perch!
Wall's in the way! Lookin' for a gap!
Can't see 'im! Where'd he go?
Hold on, hold on, gotta see 'im!
Too far! Creepin' in!
Wastin' shots! Gettin' closer!
Movin' up, movin' up.
Forward! Can't reach 'im from here!
Too close, too close! Back up!
Scurryin' back for a good shot!
Fall back! Then pelt 'im!
Need room! Backin' off!
Round the side, sneaky-like!
Get 'im from the side, he won't see!
Circlin'! Circlin'!
Straight on ain't workin'. Sneakin' round!
Hidin'! Let 'im come to me!
Wait in the dark. Then pounce!
Out of sight! He'll trip up, hehe.
Down low! Where'd the goblin go? Hehehe.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.temperamen: Hold on, hold on! I got ya, I got ya.
Easy, easy, whoever ya are. Up ya get.
Up ya get! Not so bad, eh? Heh!
Took a tumble? I patch ya up, quick quick.
Da spirits say mercy. Lie still, I tend ya.
Nobody dies where I can help it. Nobody!
Stay down, stay down! I see to ya.
One of ours is hurt! Comin, comin!
Never mind dem! I get ya outta here.
Grit ya teeth, friend. I'm here, I'm here.
You're worth da trouble. Barely! Hold still.
Somebody wit your name, lyin in da dirt? Shameful.
Need help, eh? Help costs. Costs shiny.
I get ya up. Den we talk payment, heh.
I know ya, at least. Don't make me sorry!
Fine. But I'm watchin ya hands. Both of em.
Is it safe? Is it? Oh... okay, quick quick.
Please don't let nothin come back! Hold still!
Who did dis? I bite dey nose off! Up!
Get up, get up! We find em!
Only cos it's you. Don't tell nobody!
You owe me for dis. Owe me big.
Course dis happens. Always. Hold still.
We all end up on da ground, sooner or later...
Hehehe! Look at ya down dere!
Serves ya right! No help from me, nope.
Dat's %s. Pleasure doin business, heh.
%s for my trouble. Cheap! Cheap!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.dialogue.c: My name? Mine! Not for you.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: My blade! Who took it? Thief!
You! You'll pay, you will! Pay big!
No stabby! Somebody stab for me!
Where'd it go? Where where where?
Heh! Always keep a spare one, me.
Not done yet! Stab-stab still!
Ooh, shiny one. Mine now!
Back in it! Sneaky goblin back!
Right then, who was I stabbin?
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.dialogue.c: I'm %s, yes yes. Who's askin?
%s, that's me. Don't wear it out, heh.
Eh? Me, %s! And you're who, then?
Bow! Bow to %s %s, boss of %s!
I'm %s %s, and %s is all mine, heh!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.speech.jay: Nooo! Not da flyin' again!
Eeeeeek!
I not a toothpick! I a goblin!
Now or never! Gone, gone!
Dey not lookin'... run run run!
No more chains! Find free goblins!
Free! I'm free! Shiny friend, you da best!
I owe you! Tell all da goblins!
Quick quick, before big green ones come!
Thankee thankee! Gonna run so fast!
I'm here! Want in! Work hard, no chains!
Goblins! Escaped da orcs! Got any food?
Home at last! Tell you stories 'bout da orcs!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.journal.co:
Ledger of %1$s.

Private. Very private. If you are reading dis you are %2$s and you are not allowed.

Da Book. Property of %1$s (really me).

Page numbers are lies. Some pages are also lies.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.journal.le: OWED. Folk of %1$s: 3 emeralds, 1 good knife, 1 hat (hat not returned). Paid so far: nothing. Interest: also nothing, but we are very patient. Very.
Sold %1$s a map to a place dat is not there. Ha! Sold it twice. Don't tell %2$s. %2$s want half.
Tally, honest dis time: 14 shinies in, 9 out, 5 shinies... somewhere. Not me. Ask %2$s. Look at %2$s hands.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.journal.gr: Grudge list. 1. %1$s (stole my spoon). 2. %1$s (still has spoon). 3. Everyone in %2$s (laughed). Will remember. Will remember ALL.
%1$s call me small. Me small. Dat not da point. Pages 4 to 9 is what me will do about it.
Dey say %2$s has better loot. Dey say dey will share. Dey will not share. Note: do not turn my back on %1$s.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.journal.es: If da big ones come: 1. Out da back of %1$s. 2. Not da front, da front is for da brave. 3. Run toward %2$s, dey never look dere.
Escape plan. Hole under da third tent, goes where nobody knows. Maybe. Me not tried. Don't tell da chief it is in %1$s.
If it go bad at %1$s: drop da bag, scream, run. If it go real bad: scream first. Plan is good. Plan always good.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.journal.ma: (a scribble: an X, a squiggle, a very small house) %1$s is dat way: %2$s. About %3$s blocks, or one long walk. X is where da good stuff is. X may be a stain.
Map in da margin! Look: %1$s, %2$s from here, %3$s paces more or less. Dere is a drawing of a goblin. Dat is me. Dat is not to scale.
Margin map: go %2$s. Keep going. %1$s is at da end, %3$s blocks or so. Bring a snack. Bring two.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.journal.fr: Da humming rocks. Don't touch da humming rocks. Me touched da humming rocks. Me hear colours now.
Dere is a tall broken thing in da hills and it has a heart floating on top. Dat's worth money. Don't know how. Yet.
Overheard: da stones are pieces. Pieces of what? Pieces of somewhere. Somewhere up. Dat's all me got. Dat's all anyone got.
Giants, they say. Four, they say. Me counted, dey were right. Me does not like when dey are right.
Meadow giant: gentle but heavy. Lodestone giant: pulls da coins from your pocket (rude). Frost giant: no. Sick-glow giant: DEFINITELY no.
Tried to sell a chip of da broken stone to a merchant. He went pale. He bought it. He did not want it. Did not ask why.
Old goblin story: once da sky had islands and da islands had little folk like us. Dat's why we're small. Nobody believes dat. Me sort of does.
Dere is something under da stone. A cellar maybe. Or a promise. A map says 'return'. A map says a lot of things.
Da shaman won't go near da stones after dark. Da shaman will go near ANYTHING for a coin. So dat is how scary it is.
Every big stone is shaped different. Like parts. Like parts of a key. Don't tell da chief me said key.
Da stones used to be quiet. Now dey hum. Who woke dem? Me did not. Me checked. Twice.
When one of da giants fall, da night gets meaner. Seen it. Da nasty things come out bolder. Dey were not like dat before.
Da bright lights up high, dey were doors once. Just doors. Doors to nowhere we know. Dat's still a door.
Rumour from da pedlar: whoever bring down all four will be offered a road up. Up where? He did not say. Pedlars never say where. Dey say 'up'.
